description: Price and rules for a custom wake word (the phrase that wakes the user’s assistant, e.g. "hey omarchy"), trained by Ania for omahey and Ania Player. Checks the phrase: 4–30 letters, 2–4 words (English also accepts ONE word of at least 3 syllables, like "Galadriel"), no digits/punctuation, no third-party assistant names (Alexa, Siri, Cortana, Hey Google). Shows the price (launch promo on the first wake word until 2026-12-30) in the user’s currency. Charges nothing.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

phrase.description: The wake phrase, as the user would say it.

wake_language.description: Language the wake word is spoken in (what the model listens for): en-US or pt-BR.

name: quote_wake_word
title: Quote a wake word
